answer: Price admission counter-cyclically: the joining bond is set by a curve over the current close's arrival queue, so a harbor crowded with fresh keys pays a multiplied toll, base times one plus arrivals per slot, while a lone newcomer pays base. A farm bursting N ferrous clones into one close taxes itself superlinearly instead of splitting a fixed fee, and the co-arrival spike becomes an opal signal the ledger prices automatically. Honest agents joining between bursts never fund the wall.
